method.bucketing: ~0.008-deg grid cell x category-group; buckets with >= 10 POIs; top 400 ranked
method.score_real_signals: weighted sum of 4 real observable signals (bucket = mean of POI scores)
method.density: POI count within 250 m (cKDTree), log-normalized at p99 cap
method.chain_rule: normalized name frequency >= 3 in SG slice = chain
method.citations_note: prior values are stated modeling priors; cited facts resolve via citations.json keys

method.summary: TabFormer per-merchant backbone embeddings (pre-cut pooled, scripts/fm/embed.py) are aggregated into transaction-weighted MCC-group centroids; each FSQ category group maps to a documented MCC set; a bucket's score_with_embeddings is the cosine similarity between its category group's centroid and an acceptance-anchor profile built from the most card-accepting groups
method.centroid: transaction-weighted mean of merchant embeddings (weight = n_txns_pre_cut), equal to the mean over that MCC group's pre-cut transaction encodings
method.centering: cosines computed after subtracting the corpus-wide transaction-weighted mean embedding (anisotropy correction for pooled transformer embeddings); raw cosines reported alongside
method.anchor: acceptance-weighted mean of the centroids of the most card-accepting category groups; acceptance weight = 1 minus the exhibit's own cited MDR-sensitivity prior
method.self_inclusion_note: groups inside the anchor score high partly by construction; the informative readout is the ordering of the non-anchor, MDR-sensitive groups
method.ranking_note: the page ranking stays by real signals; this column is an added signal, not a re-ranking
taxonomy_notes: MCC 5813 covers bars and nightclubs; FSQ places Night Club under Entertainment; 5813 stays in F&B per FSQ's own placement of Bars under Dining and Drinking
hospitals (8062), gambling (7995, 7801, 7802) and wholesale distribution (5045, 5094, 5192, 5193) are deliberately unmapped: no counterpart in the exhibit's card-accepting category universe
3500-3999 is the ISO 18245 lodging-chain block; observed codes map to Hotels & Lodging

mcc_code_names.5261: nurseries and lawn and garden supply
mcc_code_names.5947: gift, card, novelty and souvenir shops
